data.name: Afeefah
data.gender_notes: Afeefah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: A person who is soft and gentle, showing kindness and tenderness. Derived from the Arabic word 'afeefah' which means gentle, soft, or fragile. The name Afeefah carries the meaning “Soft, gentle, fragile” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Pashto. Parents who choose Afeefah usually hope their child will grow to embody soft, gentle, fragile and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: Symbolizes the gentle and compassionate nature of Allah towards His creation.
data.etymology: Afeefah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Soft, gentle, fragile.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Afeefah total 5, giving a life-path number of 5. Number 5 is linked with Mercury and with the qualities of freedom, adaptability and curiosity.
